sn56.36:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso yaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ tacchetvā ekajjhaṃ saṃhareyya
sn56.36:1.3: sūlaṃ katvā ye mahāsamudde mahantakā pāṇā te mahantakesu sūlesu āvuneyya ye mahāsamudde majjhimakā pāṇā te majjhimakesu sūlesu āvuneyya ye mahāsamudde sukhumakā pāṇā te sukhumakesu sūlesu āvuneyya.
sn56.36:1.4: apariyādinnā ca bhikkhave mahāsamudde oḷārikā pāṇā assu
sn56.36:2.1: atha imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.
sn56.36:2.2: ito bahutarā kho bhikkhave mahāsamudde sukhumakā pāṇā ye na sukarā sūlena āvunituṃ.
sn56.36:2.6: evaṃ mahantasmā kho bhikkhave apāyasmā parimutto diṭṭhisampanno puggalo idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn56.36:3.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
